notes.title: 1.0.0.7 Update
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We juste updated Blocks That Matter to mainly fix an annoying bug in the 1.0.0.6.
And in the same time, we added an achievement regarding "Chocolate Update" levels.

Here is the complete changelog

------------------------------
CHANGES BROUGHT BY 1.0.0.7:

BUG FIXES

- bugfix: loose some upgrade in Main Avendture when you play chocolate update on given conditions
- freeze fix: if the btm.bftm is not up to date
- crashfix: pressing TAB in the gamepad selection when no gamepad is detected
- try to solve many little issue by updating all the 'low level libraries' used by the game
- better gamepad handling (trying to avoid 'virtual gamepad' that comes inside some gamer keyboard/mouse)

FEATURES

- an achievement for finishing Chocolate Update levels
------------------------------

Thanks!

Guillaume

notes.title: Blocks That Matter Humble Update!
notes.notes:
Hi there!

As you may have noticed, we just updated the game!
This update is to celebrate the entrance of Blocks That Matter in the "Humble Voxatron Debut" bundle!
http://www.humblebundle.com/

As always, if you got any issue or suggestion, feel free to drop us a line at:
guillaume@swingswingsubmarine.com

-------

Here is what's new:

- Not so secret Chocolate Update appeared on the main screen! Bringing some levels, and news blocks/ennemies to play with!

- Soundtrack: 2 new tracks to unlock from Morusque!

- Community: new blocks and ennemies are available in the editor

- Community: 'Par system' (yellow and green stars) can be tweaked in the exist portal parameters

- Community: new icons to indicate the presence of a 'Par' or a custom BTM chest in levels

- Community: you can delete a level by pressing DEL key! (not the same effect depending the mode: creation or online browsing)

- Community: you can duplicate a level in creation mode using INSERT key! (can be used to RENAME levels or build a new level based on another one)

... and much more (check the news about the game to get the full list)

-----


Thanks!

Guillaume

notes.title: 1.0.0.5 Update
notes.notes:
Hi,

Valve just published our last tiny update to fix the annoying sorting bug in the community levels.

Here is the short change list:

CHANGES BROUGHT BY 1.0.0.5:

>> BUG FIXES

- Community levels sorting by date broken
- fix bonus level "Back to the 90s"
- avoid crashing with a level made with a recent version of the game while playing with an old version
- achievements checker fix. For achievements obtained in offline mode: Tetrobot 1.1, Tetrobot 1.2, Shake your Boˆtis, Carinae of Time, Why so Sirius

Thanks again!

Guillaume

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.4 live
notes.notes:
Hi!

The update 1.0.0.4 should be live on every Steam client, and with it the fix to the annoying drill bug I introduced in the last version thanks to my dumbness.

Here is the complete changlog for this version:

CHANGES BROUGHT BY 1.0.0.4:

>> BUG FIXES

- bugfix: the robot not correctly upgraded, unable to drill the last material for the current upgrade.
- "Big Mama is Proud of you" achievement not triggered on the right time. So it will be deleted and recreated.
- MacOS Leopard can launch the game without Steam services support (instead of crashing). Prevent for manual config file tweaking.
- Typos
- Upgraders i Community levels: sometimes an autokill was needed in order to display needed material correclty

>> FEATURES

- Dialogs.xml file can be used to write some dialog in an easier way than in editor. See "CreatorHelperDatas/NOTE on Dialogs.xml.txt" for more infos.
- btm.png file can be used to display a custom BTM at the end of a level. See "CreatorHelperDatas/NOTE on btm.png.txt" for more infos. Levels made with this feature will need an approval from us.

Thanks again for your support, patience and time with us!

Guillaume

notes.title: Blocks That Matter 1.0.0.3 Update
notes.notes:
Hi sailors,

Here are the changelogs of 1.0.0.2 and 1.0.0.3 updates :)
Now Mac OS Lion users should be able to launch the game via Steam. Please try this after the update (check that you have the 1.0.0.3 on title screen) and let us know if it works or not.

-----

CHANGES BROUGHT BY 1.0.0.3:

>> BUG FIXES

- ghost sand block when toggling puzzle mode just after drilling a sand block
- wrong tab content when returning to the level selection in the community section
- level bonus 'hanging garden' fixed

-----------------------

CHANGES BROUGHT BY 1.0.0.2:

>> BUG FIXES

- rating level : up / (down + 1) instead of up / (up + down + 1)
- Shooting star (stars that disappear when you replay without staring again an already stared level)
- auto anim ground blocks not well initialized when opening/editing a map
- [editor] editor lava blocks crash
- actor picking on various autoground always select the regular ground one
- achievement checker at launch to prevent missed ach due to offline mode
- names of custom levels not displayed in pause menu (useful to give hints... or base your puzzle on the name of the level)
- Falling blocks can crash the editor if they fall in an infinite gap (no ground under them)
- crash when skiping tabs in My Creation Section (since there is no tabs in there)
- stronger online code to try avoiding the fact that levels sometimes are not uploaded on SSS server, or uploaded with corrupted files
- Owner of a level shouldn't be able to vote for it's own level
- When level fails to load, erase if it's a Community one!
- some thumbs icons stay displayed if player vote quickly
- bug crate that give a sand block
- crashfix: sometimes game crashes when crates are not filled with 4 or more blocks
- remove (soon) from Gromy games One Eye Adventure (which is available!)
- editor actors params not in good order (now sorted alpha)
- some typos


>> FEATURES

- param NO CAM MODE on PLAYER_SPAWNER to avoid camera mode to be usable
- When level fails to load, erase if it's a Community one!
- Clean Tetrobot params
- Description on tracks for the background musics behaviour
- do not limit the blocks to 4 in a crate
- Skip texts dialog option
- Colorize the already done levels in Community mode (yellow/orange)

notes.title: Blocks That Matter 1.0.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hi,

I fear those moments, when you make a massive update to try to solve issues for some players... but in the other hand you make collateral damage by causing some trouble to others...

Here we go, Blocks That Matter has been updated, version is 1.0.0.1 (readable from main menu).

Here is the change log:

----------------------------------------------
BUG FIXES

- Windows 7 64bits won't launch (hope this will not conflict with other configuration)

- Sounds sometimes don't play in edit mode (there is also a sound bug about mini loop in one of the tracks... but i didn't figured out how to fix yet)

- in community levels: take more that 99 blocks of 1 matter freeze the game

- conflict Y button (et keyboard E) with Join group option in gamepad/keyboard configurations menus

- missing @Packaging folder in Community/MyWorkspace folder, avoiding player to submit levels of their creation (can be fixed manually by creating the folder by yourself)

- community menu: prevent thumbs up/down texts to overlap when more than 99 votes are here

- some issues in drill upgrade in community level and test/play situation (some level are broken because of that, like iron drillabe while the creator was well indicating that the Tetrobot couldn't drill iron)

- Achievement "Be our guest" fixed (auto triggered on next main menu launch)

- Achievement "Big Mama is watching" fixed (auto triggered on next main menu launch)

- Achievement "Acceptable in the 80s" fixed. Player will have to redo it, like in the 80s 



----------------------------------------------
NEED TO BE FIXED

Of course or lot of bugs remain. I won"t enumerate all here. But you certainly know what I mean if you encountered some.

One on my top priority is the OSX Lion launch from Steam issue (see: http://steamcommunity.com/games/blocksthatmatter/announcements/detail/1387327810249335849)
----------------------------------------------


Thanks again for your support and patience with use. Releasing a Java game based with Steam integration is not an easy thing... but we wanted to bring you the best experience possible, but if you run into trouble, don't hesitate to contact us via:

- my mail: guillaume (at) swingswingsubmarine (dot) com

- our forum: http://forums.steampowered.com/forums/forumdisplay.php?f=1196

- or this group page (right here in the comments)!

Thanks you again, awesome community!

Guillaume

notes.title: New Release: Blocks That Matter, 10% off
notes.notes:
Blocks That Matter is Now Available and 10% off until August 26,2011.

When indie game developers Alexey and Markus are in trouble, their only hope comes from their creation.

You are the Tetrobot: a tiny robot that can drill blocks of matter one by one, collect them, and recycle them into new pieces of 4 blocks. You also have the possibility to destroy lines of 8+ blocks in a very «retro russian» game style. Sand, wood, stone, obsidian, iron, diamond: each matter has its specific behaviour you'll have to use wisely and take advantage of them. So get ready to use your brain and combine your platforming and puzzle-solving skills in this incredible mashup!
